# glitchtip_organization (Resource)

A GlitchTip organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glitchtip_organization" "acme" {
  name = "Acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Organization display name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organization ID, assigned by GlitchTip.
- `slug` (String) URL slug, derived from the name by GlitchTip. Used to address the organization in the API and in `terraform import`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import glitchtip_organization.acme acme
```
